trigger_payload: Tier-1d demand-driven: claimable backlog starved (8 < floor 36), all remaining open items mobile-native/KMP-gated (unlandable in cloud). Need fresh LANDABLE vectors. Rotating static review; oldest-unreviewed was mobile-native-kmp (2026-08-25) but skipped as structurally-unlandable; selected oldest-unreviewed LANDABLE segment ppt-web-ui (2026-08-29, churn-corroborated by disputes/documents hotspots).

signals.evidence: features/documents/hooks/useDocumentDownload.ts:46-49 and features/documents/hooks/useMoveDocumentWithToast.ts:25-38 hardcode Slovak-only toast strings ('Stiahnutie zlyhalo', 'Dokument sa nepodarilo stiahnuť.', 'Dokument presunutý', 'Presun zlyhal', '„..." bol presunutý do priečinka.') instead of routing through react-i18next t(). App ships sk/cs/de/en — cs/de/en users see Slovak. These are churn-hotspot files (documents feature). Localization defect, not just a gap.

features/facilities/pages/MyBookingsPage.tsx:45,86 and features/facilities/pages/PendingBookingsPage.tsx:46,71,97 hardcode English toast titles/messages ('Failed to load bookings', 'Failed to cancel booking', 'Failed to approve/reject booking', 'An unexpected error occurred.') despite both pages already importing useTranslation and using t() for other copy (line 18). Inconsistent i18n — error toasts never localized for sk/cs/de.

features/accounting/pages/AccountingInvoiceManagementPage.tsx:108 gates a destructive delete behind the native browser confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this invoice?') instead of the shared <ConfirmationDialog> used elsewhere (emergency, oauth-grants), and lines 49,64 hardcode English toast titles ('Failed to create invoice', 'Failed to delete invoice'). Native confirm() is unstyleable, untranslatable, and inconsistent with the app's confirmation UX pattern.
